hero.description: Create your profile once and generate resume versions for every opportunity. Change the design, choose what to show, and export to PDF in seconds.

problem.title: The problem
items: Repeating your information every time you apply.
Resumes do not reflect the best of your profile.

solution.title: The solution
items: Create your profile once and reuse it anytime.
Generate versions for each opportunity in minutes.
You decide what to show and how to present it.

items.title: One profile, many versions
items.description: Your information centralized and ready to create tailored resumes without writing everything again.

items.title: Change the design without losing content
items.description: Explore templates and change the look of your resume while keeping all your content.

items.title: Full control over sections
items.description: Enable, hide, and reorder sections to show what truly matters.

items.title: Export ready to apply
items.description: Download your resume as an optimized PDF, ready to send in seconds.

steps.title: Create your profile
steps.description: Complete your information once. We save it for you.

steps.title: Choose a template
steps.description: Select the design that best fits your style and goal.

steps.title: Adapt your version

steps.title: Export and apply
steps.description: Export to PDF and send your resume with confidence. You are ready to move forward.

versions.title: Create different resumes for every opportunity.
